meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在本地校验基因组区间数据并规划分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组区间研究,需要在校验数据后规划模型运行
copy.tagline_en: Validate genomic interval data locally and plan analysis runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on genomic intervals and need validated, planned analysis runs

howto.what: 它帮你在 BED 文件上做基因组区间机器学习:训练 Region2Vec、BEDspace 的区域与元数据嵌入,跑 scEmbed 单细胞 ATAC-seq 嵌入,用 CC、CCF 等方法构建 consensus peaks(universe),并评估嵌入质量。
howto.when: 当你处理 BED 文件集合或 scATAC-seq 数据,或需要构建 universe 来做基于基因组区间的机器学习任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 在这些 BED 文件上训练区域嵌入
say.note: 会先做分词再训练模型

say.text: 用 CC 方法从这批 BED 文件构建 universe
say.note: 需要先准备好覆盖度文件

say.text: 检查一下我的 tokenizer 和模型是否兼容

howto.what_en: It trains Region2Vec and BEDspace region/metadata embeddings, scEmbed single-cell ATAC-seq embeddings, builds consensus peak universes from BED files, and evaluates embedding quality.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with BED file collections or scATAC-seq data, or need to build a universe for region-based machine learning tasks.

say_en.text: Train Region2Vec embeddings on these BED files
Build a universe from these BED files with the CC method
Check whether my tokenizer and model are compatible
